mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate does not decline by 1% over 6 months or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 5.3% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross the 5.3% threshold or 20-day returns are not negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When demand (HOUST) rises alongside monetary easing (FEDFUNDS falling), this dual signal strengthens equity valuations, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS falls in the next month
failure_condition: If the proxies do not exhibit the described joint behavior or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals cooling inflationary pressures, prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL does not decline sufficiently in the regime or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in demand (GDPC1) and labor demand (PAYEMS) indicate robust economic activity, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as markets anticipate sustained growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and PAYEMS rises in the next month
failure_condition: If the proxies do not rise together or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in PAYEMS below 140,000 in the next month signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 140,000 in next month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS does not fall below 140,000 or 5-day returns are not negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL simultaneously signal aggressive monetary tightening, prompting negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate recession.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises in the next month
failure_condition: If the proxies do not exhibit the described joint behavior or 60-day returns are not negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, falling UNRATE alongside FEDFUNDS easing signals strengthening labor market and policy support, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the proxies do not show the described joint behavior in the regime or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
